sources.title: Negro World newspaper (Garvey's own UNIA publication, 1918-1933)

leadership_drive.rationale: Founded the Universal Negro Improvement Association (UNIA) in 1914, which grew by the mid-1920s into the largest Pan-African organization in history -- a specific, dated, extensively documented sustained leadership achievement.

proactive_agency.rationale: Founded the Black Star Line shipping company to facilitate Black-owned trade and the broader 'Back to Africa' movement -- a specific, dated, self-initiated entrepreneurial undertaking with no precedent to follow.

risk_tolerance.rationale: Launched the capital-intensive Black Star Line as an entrepreneurial venture with real financial and legal exposure; was later convicted of mail fraud in 1923 related to its stock sales -- a specific, documented legal outcome, described here factually per the historical record (which is genuinely mixed on the underlying business conduct) rather than as a moral judgment.

persuasiveness.rationale: Built the UNIA into an organization with millions of documented members/supporters across multiple continents using sustained oratory and the Negro World newspaper, inferred as strong persuasive capability from the documented scale of the organization's growth.

social_assertiveness.rationale: Sustained public oratory and organizing across a decade-plus career implies strong social assertiveness, inferred from the documented scale of his public activity.

achievement_drive.rationale: Building the largest Pan-African organization in history from an initial founding of a handful of members implies strong achievement drive, inferred from the documented scale of the organization's eventual growth.

opportunity_sensing.rationale: Recognizing the specific post-WWI moment of heightened Black political consciousness (following wartime military service and the 'Red Summer' racial violence of 1919) as an organizing opportunity suggests real opportunity recognition, inferred from the documented timing of UNIA's rapid growth.

resourcefulness.rationale: Building a functioning shipping company from essentially no prior capital or business infrastructure implies real resourcefulness, inferred from the documented scale of the initial undertaking relative to his starting resources.

discipline.rationale: Sustaining organizational leadership and a regular newspaper publication schedule (Negro World) over more than a decade implies real behavioral discipline, inferred from the documented duration of both commitments.

independent_thinking.rationale: Pursuing a Black-nationalist, separatist organizing strategy distinct from the more integrationist approach of contemporaries like Du Bois suggests independent political judgment, inferred from the documented distinctiveness of his position relative to other Black leadership of the era.

planning_orientation.rationale: Structuring the UNIA with a formal constitution, officer hierarchy, and international chapter system implies real organizational planning, inferred from the documented institutional structure of the movement.

detail_orientation.rationale: Managing a multi-ship shipping company's logistics and finances (however imperfectly, per the later legal proceedings) implies some real attempted attention to operational detail, inferred from the documented scale of the undertaking.

collaboration.rationale: Building an international organization with local chapter leadership across multiple countries implies real sustained collaborative/delegative capacity, inferred from the documented international structure of the UNIA.

curiosity.rationale: Sustained engagement with Pan-African political philosophy, journalism, and international organizing across a career suggests broad intellectual engagement with his subject, inferred from the documented range of his activity.

persistence.rationale: Sustaining UNIA leadership and Pan-Africanist advocacy across roughly two decades, including through his 1923 conviction and subsequent deportation from the US, implies real persistence, inferred from the documented continuity of his advocacy through these setbacks.

adaptability.rationale: Continuing Pan-Africanist organizing from Jamaica and later London after his deportation from the US implies real adaptability, inferred from the documented continuation of his advocacy across these relocations.

impact_motivation.rationale: A sustained, singular life orientation toward Pan-African political and economic advancement across his career implies strong impact motivation, inferred from the documented consistency of his advocacy.

conflict_tolerance.rationale: Sustaining leadership through significant internal UNIA factional disputes and external legal/political opposition implies real tolerance for sustained conflict, inferred from the documented turbulence of his organizational career.
